title: 2026 UK ETS GHGE permit application QA controls

sources.title: UK ETS for installations: how to comply
UK ETS for installations: how to comply - publication

facts.fact: Operators carrying out regulated activities must hold an applicable permit before beginning regulated activities.
A new GHGE permit application is submitted using METS.
The guidance requires application for a new GHGE permit at least 2 months before commencing the regulated activity.
Applicants are directed to read the Monitoring and Reporting Regulation before applying.
The regulator reviews the application and may request further information.
A GHGE permit is issued after the regulator reviews and approves the application.
METS is used to send and receive regulator notifications and permit-related tasks.
METS is used to submit annual emissions and verification reports.
METS is also used for permit variation applications.
Potential New Entrant Reserve free-allocation applications are a separate eligibility and evidence process.

guard_patterns.rule: Keep GHGE installation scope distinct from HSE/USE/aviation/maritime.
Do not treat application submission as permit approval.
Preserve METS as the reporting/application channel.
Keep regulator determination separate from operator assertion.
Do not merge NER/free-allocation eligibility into permit issuance.
Do not infer physical emissions from permit status.
